parole.significato: thaw (period of weather warm enough to melt that which is frozen)
parole.testo: Of unclear origin; possibly influenced by Baltic languages (see for example Lithuanian atlėga (“relief”)). Cognate with Belarusian адлі́га (adlíha), Polish odliga.

parole.significato: a barn for storing and processing hay, wheat, etc.

parole.testo: From Baltic, cf. Lithuanian sti̇̀rta, Latvian stir̃ta. Compare also Belarusian сці́рта (scírta), Polish sterta, Russian скирд (skird), скирда́ (skirdá), borrowed from the same Baltic source.
